name: Nexora Promo Messages for WooCommerce
author: Amin

sections.description:
Nexora Promo Messages for WooCommerce allows you to display animated promotional messages on WooCommerce product pages to increase visibility and boost conversions.

Show dynamic highlights like:

✔ “Sale 20%”
✔ “Free Shipping”
✔ “Limited Time Offer”
✔ “Only 5 Left in Stock”
✔ “Best Seller”

Inspired by modern marketplace-style product marketing, this plugin helps you present promotional information in a clean, engaging, and attention-grabbing way.

You can assign different promo message sets to different products, or apply one set globally to all products.

Messages display automatically on single product pages and can also appear on shop/archive pages depending on your configuration.

Instead of static badges or theme-dependent labels, Nexora adds flexible, animated marketing highlights that integrate smoothly into your WooCommerce layout.

Built lightweight. Built fast. Built for conversions.

Key Features

  • Create reusable message sets with up to 3 promotional messages
  • Assign different message sets to different products
  • Option to apply messages globally to all products
  • Displays automatically on single product pages
  • Multiple animation styles (fade, slide, rotate)
  • Optional custom icons for each message
  • Custom styling (text color, size, alignment)
  • Lightweight vanilla JavaScript — no heavy libraries
  • Conditional loading for performance
  • Optimized database queries
  • Accessible markup with ARIA support
  • Works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme

Perfect For

  • Sales & discount promotions
  • Free shipping announcements
  • Limited stock alerts
  • Flash deals
  • Seasonal campaigns
  • Product benefits & trust signals
  • Urgency marketing strategies
  • Marketplace-style product highlights

How It Works

  1. Create a new message set
  2. Add up to 3 promotional messages
  3. Select animation style
  4. Customize appearance
  5. Assign to specific products or apply globally
  6. Publish

Messages automatically display on WooCommerce product pages.

No coding required.

Why Use Nexora Promo Messages?

Many WooCommerce stores rely on static sale badges or hardcoded theme labels.

Nexora provides:

✔ Animated promotional highlights
✔ Product-specific targeting
✔ Global assignment option
✔ Clean UI and reusable templates
✔ Performance-first architecture
✔ No unnecessary scripts or bloat

It gives your store the dynamic marketing feel of large marketplaces while keeping your site lightweight.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Nexora Promo Messages”
  3. Click Install and Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/nexora-promo-messages
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen

After Activation

  1. Navigate to Rotating Messages → Message Sets
  2. Click Add New
  3. Create your message set
  4. Assign it to products
  5. Publish
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes. It works with all WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Can I assign different messages to different products?

Yes. You can create multiple message sets and assign each one to specific products using the product selector.

Can I apply the same message to all products?

Yes. There is an option to apply a message set globally.

Will this slow down my store?

No. The plugin is optimized for performance:

  • Loads only where required
  • Minimal JavaScript
  • Lightweight animations
  • Efficient database queries

Is it translation ready?

Yes. All strings follow WordPress internationalization standards.
